name: Vet
description: Verification tool that checks whether code changes, and the agent conversations behind them, actually achieve the stated goal.
whatItDoes: Vet compares a diff against what the developer or coding agent said they were trying to do and reports mismatches and problems. It is used as a safety net after an agent finishes work. It runs from the command line, as an agent skill or in CI.
howItWorks: The user passes the goal as text and optionally a base commit. Vet gathers the changes and any conversation history and has a model look for issues. An agentic mode hands the investigation to an existing coding agent harness.

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Model key for the default provider

models: Anthropic by default; other providers configurable
